title: Naiga Dna Naiga Gniksamkcab
description: Naiga Dna Naiga Gniksamkcab — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Tipper Gourd

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill Shadow Mutants in the lower areas of The Mutanous Malaise in order to collect 30 of The Beastlies and 30 Dead Xeplin albums. Head into the lower areas, including the side dungeons; of the Mutanous Malaise to Kill Fire Fade creatures until you have collected 30 Schrutist Preest and 30 Fozzy Ozbear albums. Once completed, return to Tipper Gourd in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Tipper Gourd

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Mutanous Malaise

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Shadow Mutants in the lower areas of The Mutanous Malaise in order to collect 30 of The Beastlies and 30 Dead Xeplin albums. Head into the lower areas, including the side dungeons; of the Mutanous Malaise to Kill Fire Fade creatures until you have collected 30 Schrutist Preest and 30 Fozzy Ozbear albums. Once completed, return to Tipper Gourd in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine.

Offer:

I need more proof through the display of many more records. Keep 'procuring' these records for me, so that I can pile them high in the town. I keep collecting all of these records and showing them to my friends, but they refuse to believe. One by one, I'm losing my friends to these records. It seems everytime I present my case, that another leaves. I must get more. I believe my friends are losing their sense of righteousness. They are becoming desensitized to the messages, both forwards and backwards. I must have more to prove to them, to everyone, that I am not making this up. Our children will not be lost in this war.

Head back into Mutanous Malaise and obtain at least 30 records of each the artists known as The Beastlies, Dead Xeplin, Schrutist Preest, and Fozzy Ozbear. I, Tipper Gourd, am thankful I have you to help. Everyone else thinks I'm off my rocker. They live in perversion, what do they know? Find me in The Mutanous Malaise Mezzanine when you have finished. I have a reward waiting for my gratitude.

Turn-in:

Yes, this is a great collection...but I will need more. Much more.

Objectives:

  • Yodel at The Moon LP ×30
  • Stained Glass Bear LP ×30
  • The Gray Album ×30
  • Runes LP ×30

Client level range: 42–55
